{{Quote|Dun'La is our best healer. He'll stay with the Admiral while Drok and I join your fighters.|Te Corso, to Captain Jhoram Bey|<ref name="leg42" />}}
'''Sayar Dun'La''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]] present at the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order's]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] when it was visited by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cade Skywalker]] in [[137 ABY]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Skywalker sought to gain the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council's]] assistance in [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]. The Council refused, however, choosing to pursue a potential alliance with the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|remnants of the Galactic Alliance]] and the [[Empire-in-exile|forces]] of [[Attack on Emperor Fel|deposed]] Emperor [[Roan Fel]]. Dun'La, along with three other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], was sent to meet with the leader of the Galactic Alliance Remnant, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]. Yet during their discussions, a crewmember of Stazi's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']], shot the Admiral, and the [[Core Fleet|Alliance Fleet]] was attacked by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Imperial forces]].

Rushing to aid Stazi, Dun'La took the Admiral to the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Medical bay/Legends|sick bay]], where he treated him for his injuries while the [[First Coruscant Task Force|Imperial fleet]] continued to pursue the Alliance forces through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. When Stazi woke, he refused to go into a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] until he had spoken to his second-in-command, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jhoram Bey]]. After Dun'La patched Stazi through to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], the Admiral was able to provide Bey with the tactic needed to overcome the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Following the battle, Dun'La and the other Jedi were able to form a tentative pact with the Galactic Alliance Remnant.

In [[138 ABY]], Lord Krayt launched an [[attack on the Hidden Temple]], and Dun'La was among the Jedi who fought the Sith Imperial ground forces. The Jedi planned to evacuate the planet, and Jedi Master [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] was gathering the energy of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to create a [[beam of light]] that could allow the evacuation ships to escape the enemy fleet. While defending Master Saa in the Jedi Council chambers, Dun'La was struck down by one of [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper]]s.

==Biography==
===Forming an alliance===
{{Quote|Alive, but his life force flickers. We must get him to the sickbay immediately.|Sayar Dun'La, after examining Admiral Gar Stazi|<ref name="leg42" />}}
A [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]],<ref name="leg42" /> Sayar Dun'La was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="legwar4" /> in the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] in [[137 ABY]].<ref name="leg42" /> Dun'La was stationed at the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]]&mdash;where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had fled after the [[One Sith]] [[Massacre at Ossus|massacred]] members of the Order on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] [[130 ABY|seven years prior]]&mdash;around the [[Time/Legends|time]] that the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cade Skywalker]], descendant of Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], came to the Temple in order to request the Jedi's aid in [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]. Dun'La was present for Skywalker's arrival, as well as the arrival of a ship carrying [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] and a group of [[Imperial Knight]]s. Skywalker and the Imperial Knights confronted each other and almost came to blows when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wolf Sazen]], along with Dun'La and the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] Jedi [[Drok]], intervened.<ref name="leg25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref> The [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] refused Skywalker's request and chose instead to pursue a potential alliance with the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|remnants of the Galactic Alliance]] and the [[Empire-in-exile|forces]] of [[Attack on Emperor Fel|deposed]] Emperor [[Roan Fel]].<ref name="leg26" />

[[File:DunLa-Leg42.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Dun'La in the ''Alliance'' medical bay]]
After Skywalker apparently succeeded in [[Battle on Had Abbadon|his mission]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Krayt, Dun'la&mdash;along with fellow Jedi [[Asaak Dan]], Drok, and [[Te Corso]]&mdash;was sent by the Council to discuss the possibility of joining the Alliance and Empire-in-exile in the fight against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Traveling to the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Core Fleet|Alliance Fleet]], the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']], aboard their [[X-83 TwinTail starfighter]]s, Dun'La and his fellow Jedi were greeted by the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Alliance Remnant, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]. Their conversation was interrupted, however, by [[Imperial Knight]] [[Sigel Dare]]&mdash;representing the Empire-in-exile&mdash;who wished to use one of the Alliance's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] to travel to the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] to retrieve her former [[Master]], [[Treis Sinde]]. Intrigued by Sinde's history, Asaak Dan offered to accompany Dare on her mission; and, after Stazi convinced the Imperial Knight to allow the Jedi to join her, the two left for Dac while Dun'La and the remaining Jedi were taken to discuss the Council's offer with the Admiral in private.<ref name="leg42" />

While Stazi and his second-in-command, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jhoram Bey]], discussed the Jedi's presence on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Alliance'', Te Corso sensed a disturbance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] just before the Alliance [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was [[Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet|attacked]] by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Imperial]] [[First Coruscant Task Force]]. Just as Stazi began ordering his fleet into action, however, he was shot by one of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] crew, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Tealart]], who was quickly disarmed by Drok. Rushing to the Admiral's side, Dun'La felt Stazi's life force flickering and quickly [[Telekinesis/Legends|lifted]] his body with the Force to carry the Admiral to the [[Medical bay/Legends|sick bay]]. There, the Bothan was able to stabilize Stazi's condition, though his wound was serious.<ref name="leg42" />

While the Alliance Fleet fled from the Imperials through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Dun'La and the [[Unidentified Alliance medic|ship's medic]] continued to treat Stazi. The Imperial fleet followed the Galactic Alliance, managing to track their coordinates and attack the Alliance shortly after the fleet left hyperspace. When the Admiral awoke, he refused to go into a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] until he had spoken to Bey, so Dun'La patched him through to the bridge. Stazi told Bey to use their fleet's frequency vibrations to his advantage. With this knowledge, Bey was able to understand how the Imperials had managed to follow them through hyperspace by using the frequency vibrations from the Alliance's [[Comm unit/Legends|comm array]] like a beacon. Bey managed to outmaneuver the [[Krion Grail|Sith Imperial commander]] by having only the ''Alliance'' waiting for the Imperial fleet when it left hyperspace for another attack, before the rest of the Galactic Alliance Fleet jumped into the area from behind to trap them.<ref name="leg42" />

Following the Alliance victory over the First [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] Task Force, Dun'La and the other Jedi were able to form a tentative pact with Stazi's command, and the Jedi Council agreed to meet with Emperor-in-exile Roan Fel on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] to further discuss working together in the war.<ref name="leg43">[[Legacy (2006) 43|''Legacy'' (2006) 43]]</ref>

===Death===
{{Quote|Masters Dun'La, Te Corso, Drok&mdash;stick with Cade and me. Cover Master Saa until she's ready.|Bantha Rawk giving orders during the battle|<ref name="legwar4" />}}
[[File:DeathofSayarDunla.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Sayar Dun'La is slain defending the Hidden Temple.]]
In [[138 ABY]], following the return of Lord Krayt,<ref name="leg48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref> the Dark Lord of the Sith launched an [[attack on the Hidden Temple]],<ref name="legwar3">[[Legacy — War 3|''Legacy — War'' 3]]</ref> having learned its location from a [[Antares Draco|captured Imperial Knight]].<ref name="legwar2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref> The Jedi were joined by members of the Alliance Remnant and Empire-in-exile in defending Taivas, and Dun'La was among the Jedi who battled the Sith Imperial ground forces. With the aid of Lord Krayt's [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]], the Sith gained the upper hand in the battle. The Jedi had a plan, however; the Neti Jedi Master [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] was gathering the energy of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to create a [[beam of light]] that could allow the evacuation ships to escape the Sith Imperial fleet.<ref name="legwar4" />

In the Jedi Council chambers, Dun'La&mdash;along with Cade Skywalker, Rawk, Drok, and Te Corso&mdash;battled the Sith troopers in order to protect Saa. Just as Master Saa gave the signal for the evacuation ships to take off, Dun'La was struck down by one of the Sith troopers. A damaged [[Annihilator-class starfighter|''Annihilator''-class starfighter]] set a collision course on the remains of the temple, and as it collided, Rawk helped Master Saa unleash the energy she had gathered. The beam of light annihilated any ships in its path, leaving an opening in the Sith Imperial fleet through which the Jedi and their allies were able to escape.<ref name="legwar4" />

==Personality and traits==
Sayar Dun'La was a Bothan with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="leg26" /> A respected Jedi healer, Dun'La was trusted by the Jedi Council with being one of the four Jedi sent to discuss the possibility of joining the Galactic Alliance Remnant and Empire-in-exile in the fight against the Sith.<ref name="leg42" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Dun'La to bridge. The Admiral is stabilized but the wound is ''very'' bad.|Sayar Dun'La|<ref name="leg42" />}}
Sayar Dun'La was regarded as one of the Jedi Order's best Jedi healers. When Admiral Gar Stazi was shot on the bridge of the ''Alliance'', Dun'La's fellow Jedi had complete faith in his abilities to look after the Admiral, and Dun'La was able to stabilize Stazi's condition. Aside from his healing abilities, Dun'La was also skilled with telekinesis, able to lift Stazi's body and carry him to the sickbay.<ref name="leg42" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Character_sketch_jedi_by_chrisscalf.jpg|left|thumb|Sayar Dun'la sketch by [[Chris Scalf]]]]
Sayar Dun'La first appeared as an unnamed character in the twenty-fifth [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', [[Legacy (2006) 25|''The Hidden Temple, Part 1'']], released in [[June]] [[2008]].<ref name="leg25" /> He then appeared on the cover of the twenty-sixth issue, [[Legacy (2006) 26|''The Hidden Temple, Part 2'']], released in [[July]] 2008, with the cover art drawn by [[Omar Francia]].<ref name="leg26" /> Due to a surplus of characters in the story, Dun'La and the other three Jedi from the cover of ''Legacy 26'' were not used in the actual comic itself. Originally, they were to accompany Cade Skywalker against the wishes of the Jedi Council in his hunt for Darth Krayt.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28816293|board=Literature|thread=Legacy #26: The Hidden Temple, part 2 (of 2)|user=[[John Ostrander|jfostrander01]]|date=2008-07-23|time=8:46 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180304152321/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/legacy-26-the-hidden-temple-part-2-of-2.28287244/page-4}}</ref> Dun'La later appeared in the forty-second issue of the comic series, [[Legacy (2006) 42|''Legacy'' (2006) 42]], in which he was first identified. The issue was released in [[November]] [[2009]] and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Dave Ross]].<ref name="leg42" /> Dun'La returned in the [[Legacy — War 4|fourth issue]] of the sequel to ''Legacy'' series, [[Star Wars: Legacy — War|''Star Wars: Legacy—War'']].<ref name="legwar4" />
